description: 「地震時等の電気火災の発生・延焼等の危険解消に取り組むべき地域」の指定の参考となる不燃領域率及び戸建て住宅密度、木防建ぺい率の推計値に係るデータ 01 [electricity and power and earthquakes] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 内閣府　大規模地震時の電気火災の発生・抑制に関する検討会. 「大規模地震時の電気火災発生抑制に関する検討会」の検討において提言された「地震時等の電気火災の発生・延焼等の危険解消に取り組むべき地域」の指定の際に、地方自治体が活用するためのデータである。 【提供データ】 ・不燃領域率推計値 ・戸建て住宅密度 ・木防建ぺい率推計値. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 47 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 内閣府　大規模地震時の電気火災の発生・抑制に関する検討会. It offers 3 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
